metadata.name: rv_n_good_obs_primary
metadata.description: Total number of radial velocities actually used for the primary

metadata.name: rv_n_obs_secondary
metadata.description: Total number of radial velocities considered for the secondary in the case of SB2

metadata.name: rv_n_good_obs_secondary
metadata.description: Total number of radial velocities actually used for the secondary in the case of SB2

metadata.name: phot_g_n_obs
metadata.description: Total number of G photometry measurements considered

metadata.name: phot_g_n_good_obs
metadata.description: Total number of G photometry measurements actually used

metadata.name: bit_index
metadata.description: boolean mask for the fields above in the corrVec matrix

metadata.name: corr_vec
metadata.description: Vector form of the upper triangle of the correlation matrix (column-major ordered)

metadata.name: obj_func
metadata.description: value of the objective function at the solution

metadata.name: goodness_of_fit
metadata.description: goodness of fit in the Hipparcos sense

metadata.name: efficiency
metadata.description: Efficiency of the solution

metadata.name: significance
metadata.description: The significance of the solution (i.e. how worth keeping a model is)

metadata.name: flags
metadata.description: Quality flag for the achieved NSS solution

metadata.name: conf_spectro_period
metadata.description: The probability of the period for not being due to (gaussian white) noise. Relevant for SB1, SB1C, SB2 and SB2C models. To be ignored otherwise.

metadata.name: r_pole_sum
metadata.description: Sum of the polar radii of primary and secondary (in units of the semi-major axis)

metadata.name: r_l1_point_sum
metadata.description: L1-pointing radii of primary and secondary (in units of the semi-major axis)

metadata.name: r_spher_sum
metadata.description: Sum of the radii of sphere having the same volume as the primary and secondary (in units of the semi-major axis

metadata.name: ecl_time_primary
metadata.description: Time of mid-eclipse of the primary by the secondary

metadata.name: ecl_time_secondary
metadata.description: Time of mid-eclipse of the secondary by the primary

metadata.name: ecl_dur_primary
metadata.description: Duration of primary eclipse assuming spherical components

metadata.name: ecl_dur_secondary
metadata.description: Duration of secondary eclipse assuming spherical components

metadata.name: g_luminosity_ratio
metadata.description: Ratio of the G-band luminosity of the secondary over the primary

metadata.name: input_period_error
metadata.description: Standard error of the period taken from VariEclipsingBinary.frequencyError

metadata.name: g_rank
metadata.description: Rank of the G-band solution

metadata.name: astrometric_jitter
metadata.description: Uncorrelated astrometric jitter term
